solution: [Textbook answer-key error: NCERT answer key marks option (D); the printed options are (A) 6, (B) 0, (C) 3, (D) 4 and the value of the integral is 6, i.e. option (A) — which this bank marks correct.] Factor \(x^3\) inside the cube root: \((x-x^3)^{1/3}=x\,\big(\tfrac{1}{x^2}-1\big)^{1/3}\), so the integrand is \(\dfrac{(1/x^2-1)^{1/3}}{x^3}\). Put \(t=\tfrac{1}{x^2}-1\), so \(dt=-\tfrac{2}{x^3}\,dx\); limits \(x=\tfrac13\Rightarrow t=8\), \(x=1\Rightarrow t=0\). Then \(\int_{1/3}^{1}\dfrac{(x-x^3)^{1/3}}{x^4}\,dx=\tfrac12\int_0^8 t^{1/3}\,dt=\tfrac12\cdot\tfrac34\,t^{4/3}\Big|_0^8=\tfrac38\cdot 16=6\). Hence the value is \(6\), option (A).
